newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil weakens further as futures, diffs ease.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil weakens further as futures, diffs ease.

text.p: NWE gas oil eased on Thursday in line with benchmark IPE gas oil prices and sinking premiums, traders said.
They said business had been fairly quiet with the expiry of the June gas oil contract muting trade especially on the barge market.
The June contract expired flat against Wednesday's close at $162.25 a tonne, while the July contract settled +$1.50 lower at $162.25 a tonne.
On the barge market, heating oil premiums were quoted at July IPE +50 cents/+$1.0 fob ARA for second half June delivery.

Low sulphur premiums were under pressure with diffs quoted at July +6.0/+$7.0 fob ARA. Some low sulphur barge material was reported to have traded at July IPE +$7.0 fob ARA although a number of traders were dubious about this number.
On the cargo front, German DIN was offered around July +$1.0 cif NWE.
EN590 material was also still under pressure as healthy supplies amid slack demand pushed premiums lower. Diffs were assessed around July IPE +$5.50/+$6.50 cif NWE.
Traders said the Mediterranean EN590 material was continuing to move into the area. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
